From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@clearwavehealth.com>

Cc: procurement@clearwavehealth.com
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: KMS/BYOK handshake — roles & responsibility matrix

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Clearwave is preparing the compliance packet for our security committee and we need to capture the operational responsibilities for a BYOK integration. Specifically we need: 

- Ownership for key lifecycle (who performs rotations / revocations).
- Access path for audit logs tied to keys (what logs exist, retention window, granularity).
- Proof points for key custody (who holds key material at rest vs in transit).
- Short-term retention carveout flow (we may need 7 years for a subset of records; how would that be handled?).
- SSO/KMS handshake steps for provisioning and deprovisioning users.

I've attached a short questionnaire (clearwave_kms_questions.xlsx) — can you review and return a RACI or point us to the owner(s)? Ideally we have a single doc the security committee can review.

Best,
Elaine Park
Director, Security Operations
Clearwave Health

- Custody proofs / attestations: Security (Monica Patel) — evidence for SOC2 / audit bundles.
- Retention carveouts / exceptions: Product (Marissa Cole) + Legal — define data flows and retention policies.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll attach a proposed RACI (proposed_raci_matrix.xlsx) for your review.
2) Product/security workshop: 30–45m to agree owners and timelines.
3) 2‑week spike for a keystore-proxy feasibility (internal), then demo to Clearwave.

Can your team do a quick review of the attached RACI and share any internal reviewers we should include on the workshop invite?

Thanks — will follow up with calendar options.

— Karthik Iyer

Karthik / team — reviewed Elaine's questionnaire and the RACI. A few clarifying points from product perspective:

- Retention carveouts: if Clearwave needs a 7‑year window for a subset, that is functionally different from our default ephemeral retention flows. We should map whether this is per‑tenant policy (configurable) or a one‑off exception requiring an escrow/archival path.
- UX/API surface for SSO/KMS handshake: we need to define two APIs — (1) provisioning/binding (one-time handshake), (2) deprovisioning/rotation hooks. Product can spec (1) in ~1 week; (2) will require infra involvement for safe rollbacks.
- Timeline ask: for commitment to provide RACI + spike plan to Clearwave security, can we commit to an internal triage + final RACI by 2028-08-16? That gives product one sprint to spec the API and infra to estimate the spike cost.

Action items I’m proposing: 
- Marissa: spec the SSO/KMS handshake API (due 2028-08-15).
- Jonas: estimate keystore-proxy spike effort and signal if we need dedicated GPU/private infra changes (due 2028-08-14).
- Monica: prepare list of audit artifacts we can share (non-sensitive) and SOC2 crosswalk (due 2028-08-15).

Also — if Clearwave insists on 7‑year retention as a requirement to sign, we should surface that as a commercial exception (billing/legal).

Marissa Cole
Group PM, Data Governance
Redwood Inference

Thanks — a few infra/security constraints and recommendations:

- Keystore-proxy feasibility: we can do a two-week spike to validate a proxy that mediates key operations without storing raw key material on our hosts. Outcome: a small PoC and a risk assessment. Need 3 engineer-weeks (2 engineers x 1 week + 1 infra engineer x 1 week) and a short test plan.
- Audit logs: we can expose key-event logs (rotate/revoke/bind) with per-event timestamps and actor ids. Default retention is 90 days; extending to multi-year requires an archival pipeline and legal sign-off.
- Emergency revoke flow: must include a verified out-of-band confirmation for customer-managed keys — this has operational implications for SLA and pacing.

Proposed internal action matrix (owners):
- Spike & PoC: Jonas Weber (owner for infra execution)
- API spec: Marissa Cole (owner for API/UX)
- Evidence bundle + SOC2 mapping: Monica Patel (security)
- Customer comms & commercial exception: Karthik Iyer (owner to coordinate with sales/procurement)

I’ll start the spike as soon as we have headcount assigned. If Clearwave requires 7-year retention we should route that as a formal exception (legal + finance) — target to surface commercial impact in time for next week’s review.

Jonas Weber
Director, Infrastructure & Security
Redwood Inference
